title: Large dam: notice to fix for work without consent (Seddon)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Authority issued a notice to fix under s40 for work carried out to a large dam at Seddon; owner and authority disagree on the scope of works that required consent.
Discussion in §6 (pp.9–19) addresses whether the dam works were building work requiring consent.
Decision: authority correct to issue the notice to fix for a contravention of s40, but the notice is modified as set out in para 6.72 (30 November 2022).

limitations: Comparative only: a New Zealand determination used to test attachment format and content; it cannot establish Alberta performance or applicability.
